parameters.query:
UPDATE batches SET status = 'matching' WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid
RETURNING batch_id, row_count, status

SELECT product_id, source_site, product_name, interest_rate, min_income, min_credit_score,
       min_age, max_age, allowed_employment_types, eligibility_rules, qualitative_criteria_text,
       raw_criteria_text, last_crawled_at
FROM loan_products
WHERE last_crawled_at > now() - interval '7 days'
ORDER BY product_id

WITH gone AS (
    DELETE FROM matches m
    USING users u
    WHERE u.batch_id = $1::uuid AND m.user_id = u.user_id AND m.notified_at IS NULL
    RETURNING 1
)
DELETE FROM match_candidates WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid

WITH ids AS (
    SELECT (jsonb_array_elements_text($2::jsonb))::bigint AS product_id
), ins AS (
    INSERT INTO match_candidates (batch_id, user_id, product_id)
    SELECT $1::uuid, u.user_id, p.product_id
    FROM users u
    JOIN loan_products p ON p.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM ids)
    WHERE u.batch_id = $1::uuid
      AND u.monthly_income >= COALESCE(p.min_income, 0)
      AND u.credit_score   >= COALESCE(p.min_credit_score, 0)
      AND u.age BETWEEN COALESCE(p.min_age, 0) AND COALESCE(p.max_age, 200)
      AND (p.allowed_employment_types IS NULL OR u.employment_status = ANY (p.allowed_employment_types))
    RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid) AS users_in_batch,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM ids)                             AS products,
       count(*)                                               AS stage1_pairs
FROM ins

WITH upd AS (
    UPDATE match_candidates mc
    SET exact_ok = TRUE
    FROM users u, loan_products p
    WHERE mc.batch_id = $1::uuid
      AND u.user_id = mc.user_id
      AND p.product_id = mc.product_id
      AND (
          p.eligibility_rules IS NULL
          OR EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.eligibility_rules) AS r
              WHERE u.employment_status IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(r -> 'employment_types'))
                AND u.monthly_income >= COALESCE((r ->> 'min_income')::int, 0)
                AND u.credit_score   >= COALESCE((r ->> 'min_credit_score')::int, 0)
                AND u.age BETWEEN COALESCE((r ->> 'min_age')::int, 0) AND COALESCE((r ->> 'max_age')::int, 200)
          )
      )
    RETURNING 1
)
SELECT count(*) AS stage2_pairs FROM upd

SELECT p.product_id,
       p.product_name,
       p.qualitative_criteria_text,
       md5('rv3|' || p.qualitative_criteria_text || E'\n' || COALESCE(p.raw_criteria_text, '')) AS criteria_hash,
       left(COALESCE(p.raw_criteria_text, ''), 1500)                     AS source_text,
       array_to_string(p.allowed_employment_types, ', ')                 AS accepted_types,
       u.employment_status                                               AS employment_type,
       count(*)                                                          AS candidates,
       min(u.monthly_income)                                             AS income_min,
       (percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY u.monthly_income))::int AS income_median,
       max(u.monthly_income)                                             AS income_max,
       min(u.credit_score)                                               AS score_min,
       max(u.credit_score)                                               AS score_max,
       min(u.age)                                                        AS age_min,
       max(u.age)                                                        AS age_max
FROM match_candidates mc
JOIN users u          ON u.user_id = mc.user_id
JOIN loan_products p  ON p.product_id = mc.product_id
LEFT JOIN qualitative_reviews r
       ON r.product_id = p.product_id AND r.employment_type = u.employment_status
WHERE mc.batch_id = $1::uuid
  AND mc.exact_ok
  AND p.qualitative_criteria_text IS NOT NULL
  AND r.criteria_hash IS DISTINCT FROM md5('rv3|' || p.qualitative_criteria_text || E'\n' || COALESCE(p.raw_criteria_text, ''))
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.qualitative_criteria_text, p.raw_criteria_text,
         p.allowed_employment_types, u.employment_status
ORDER BY p.product_id, u.employment_status

WITH ins AS (
    INSERT INTO qualitative_reviews (product_id, employment_type, criteria_hash, verdict, caveat, provider)
    SELECT (r->>'product_id')::bigint, r->>'employment_type', r->>'criteria_hash',
           r->>'verdict', r->>'caveat', r->>'provider'
    FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS r) x
    WHERE (r->>'valid')::boolean
    ON CONFLICT (product_id, employment_type) DO UPDATE SET
        criteria_hash = EXCLUDED.criteria_hash, verdict = EXCLUDED.verdict,
        caveat = EXCLUDED.caveat, provider = EXCLUDED.provider, reviewed_at = now()
    RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ins) AS saved

WITH ins AS (
    INSERT INTO matches (user_id, product_id, match_method)
    SELECT mc.user_id, mc.product_id,
           CASE WHEN r.verdict IS NOT NULL THEN 'llm' ELSE 'numeric' END
    FROM match_candidates mc
    JOIN users u         ON u.user_id = mc.user_id
    JOIN loan_products p ON p.product_id = mc.product_id
    LEFT JOIN qualitative_reviews r
           ON r.product_id = mc.product_id
          AND r.employment_type = u.employment_status
          AND r.criteria_hash = md5('rv3|' || p.qualitative_criteria_text || E'\n' || COALESCE(p.raw_criteria_text, ''))
    WHERE mc.batch_id = $1::uuid
      AND mc.exact_ok
      AND COALESCE(r.verdict, 'conditional') <> 'ineligible'
    ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM match_candidates WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid AND exact_ok) AS stage2_pairs,
       count(*)                                                                        AS matches_written,
       (SELECT count(*)
          FROM match_candidates mc
          JOIN users u ON u.user_id = mc.user_id
          JOIN loan_products p ON p.product_id = mc.product_id
          JOIN qualitative_reviews r ON r.product_id = mc.product_id
                                    AND r.employment_type = u.employment_status
                                    AND r.criteria_hash = md5('rv3|' || p.qualitative_criteria_text || E'\n' || COALESCE(p.raw_criteria_text, ''))
         WHERE mc.batch_id = $1::uuid AND mc.exact_ok AND r.verdict = 'ineligible')      AS dropped_by_llm,
       (SELECT count(*)
          FROM (SELECT DISTINCT mc.product_id, u.employment_status
                  FROM match_candidates mc
                  JOIN users u ON u.user_id = mc.user_id
                  JOIN loan_products p ON p.product_id = mc.product_id
                 WHERE mc.batch_id = $1::uuid AND mc.exact_ok
                   AND p.qualitative_criteria_text IS NOT NULL) seg)                     AS segments_total
FROM ins

UPDATE batches SET status = 'matched', matched_at = now(), match_stats = $2::jsonb
WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid
RETURNING batch_id, status, match_stats
